scope: Synthetic engineering feasibility only; one independent reliability system per frozen locator.

availability.threshold_rule: On CALIBRATION only: require unavailable recall >= 0.90 and maximize available recall; if infeasible, maximize balanced accuracy.

bad30.threshold_rule: On CALIBRATION only: require BAD30 recall >= 0.80 and maximize safe-row acceptance; if infeasible, maximize balanced accuracy.

untouched_test_lock: No locator inference or reliability evaluation on UNTOUCHED_TEST until all six logistic models and six thresholds are frozen.
